first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, directly signaling friction in the self-serve flow. Memory_31 and memory_86 both show that simplification and shortening onboarding drive measurable activation and adoption gains. Verifying these two will confirm the magnitude of past lift and whether those gains held. The current decline makes this a high-confidence intervention: we're reversing a negative trend with proven levers rather than chasing new channels. Promotional pricing would address competitor pressure but doesn't address our internal activation decay—and price wars are harder to scale sustainably. Enterprise sales assist is strong long-term but won't move this week's metrics. By targeting onboarding simplification at standard scale, we address both the 4% completion drop and the 6% activation decline (memory_91 shows activation messaging compounds onboarding gains), while preserving room to learn before broader rollout.
